domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: The actor who applies for leave and whose balances are tracked. Manager relationship (managerId) drives the approval chain.

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: A single application for leave by an employee, moving through an approval workflow. The central aggregate of the leave module.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories (annual, sick, emergency, etc.) with per-type approval and pay semantics.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines entitlement, accrual, accumulation caps, and notice requirements for a leave type. Governs balance computation and request eligibility.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's entitlement, used, pending, and remaining days for a leave type within a fiscal year. Deducted on approval, reserved on submission.

domain_entities.name: Notification
domain_entities.purpose: Notifies employees and managers of leave request lifecycle events (submitted, approved, rejected, cancelled).

domain_entities.name: AuditLog
domain_entities.purpose: Immutable record of every state-changing operation on leave entities (GP-002).

business_rules: Leave duration is measured in calendar days, inclusive of both startDate and endDate: durationDays = endDate - startDate + 1. This count is used uniformly for balance reservation, deduction, and sufficiency checks. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest duration / LeaveBalance appears, not only here]

A leave request's startDate must be on or after the employee's hireDate, and must not fall on or after terminationDate when employmentStatus is TERMINATED. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest / Employee appears, not only here]

On SUBMITTED, the request's durationDays are reserved against the employee's LeaveBalance.pendingDays for the matching leave type and fiscal year; on APPROVED they move from pendingDays to usedDays; on REJECTED or CANCELLED the reservation is released from pendingDays. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest / LeaveBalance appears, not only here]

A request may only be submitted if remainingDays (totalEntitlement - usedDays - pendingDays) for the matching leave type and fiscal year is >= durationDays. Unpaid leave types are exempt from this sufficiency check. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest / LeaveBalance / LeaveType appears, not only here]

Approval must be performed by the employee's manager (managerId) or a user with an elevated role; an employee cannot approve their own request. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest / Employee appears, not only here]

When a policy sets minimumNoticeDays, the request's startDate must be at least minimumNoticeDays calendar days after the submission date (startDate - submissionDate >= minimumNoticeDays). Emergency leave types are exempt from the notice requirement. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest / LeavePolicy / LeaveType appears, not only here]

A request may only be cancelled by its employee while in SUBMITTED or APPROVED state; cancellation after APPROVED releases the used days back to the balance. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest / LeaveBalance appears, not only here]

Every state-changing operation on a LeaveRequest (create, submit, approve, reject, cancel) writes an AuditLog record with the actor's id (GP-002). [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest / AuditLog appears, not only here]

A fiscal year is identified by the calendar year in which it ends; a request's fiscal year is derived from its startDate. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveBalance / LeaveRequest appears, not only here]
domain_notes: Leave management domain slice. Entities: Employee (ACTIVE/INACTIVE/TERMINATED), LeaveRequest (DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED), LeaveType (ACTIVE/INACTIVE), LeavePolicy (ACTIVE/INACTIVE), LeaveBalance (ACTIVE/EXHAUSTED/CLOSED), Notification (PENDING/SENT/READ/ARCHIVED), AuditLog (immutable, no lifecycle). LeaveRequest is the central aggregate; LeaveBalance tracks entitlement/used/pending/remaining per employee+policy+fiscalYear. Key cross-boundary rules: inclusive calendar-day duration (endDate-startDate+1) used uniformly for reservation/deduction/sufficiency; pending reservation on SUBMITTED, moved to used on APPROVED, released on REJECTED/CANCELLED; manager-only approval (no self-approval); minimumNoticeDays with emergency exemption; audit on every state change (GP-002). Open questions flagged for chief architect: calendar vs business days, fiscal-year boundary/carry-over, sick/emergency balance pooling and approval, and cross-fiscal-year request handling.

open_questions.question: Should leave duration be measured in calendar days or business (working) days, and should weekends/public holidays be excluded from the count?
open_questions.impact: Affects the durationDays formula used for balance reservation, deduction, and sufficiency checks across all leave types. A wrong choice silently under- or over-allocates entitlements.
candidate_options: Business days excluding public holidays (requires a holiday calendar)

open_questions.question: How is the fiscal year boundary defined for balance accrual and carry-over (e.g. calendar year Jan 1–Dec 31 vs. a company-specific fiscal year), and is unused annual leave carried over or forfeited?
open_questions.impact: Determines which LeaveBalance row a request maps to, when balances reset, and whether maxAccumulation caps apply at year rollover.
candidate_options: Calendar year with carry-over up to maxAccumulation
Company fiscal year (configurable start month) with carry-over

open_questions.question: Should sick and emergency leave be deducted from the same annual entitlement pool or tracked as separate balances, and do they require manager approval?
open_questions.impact: Affects the number of LeaveBalance rows per employee and whether the approval workflow applies to all leave types or only annual leave.
candidate_options: Separate balances per leave type, all require approval
Single shared pool for all paid leave

open_questions.question: Can a leave request span multiple fiscal years, and if so how is the duration split across the two balances?
open_questions.impact: Affects balance reservation/deduction logic and whether a single request maps to one or multiple LeaveBalance rows.
candidate_options: Allow and split days proportionally across fiscal years
Allow and charge entirely to the startDate's fiscal year
